expect.header: Ways to build that feeling into a post
expect.bodytext:
• Write about shared rituals instead of only decoration.
  • Let weather become part of the story rather than a problem.
  • Use images that suggest movement, care, or reassurance.
  • Keep the tone personal and steady.

expect.header: Connection is often the real Easter story
expect.bodytext: Behind the eggs, decorations, and spring meals, Easter often comes down to one simple thing: people staying close to one another. An image of an adult holding a child's hand says that directly. It turns the season away from objects and back toward care, guidance, and ordinary moments that feel more important in changing weather.
